description.value: L'Abattoir is a Michelin-recommended French-West Coast restaurant housed in a 19th-century brick-and-beam building in historic Gastown, on the site of Vancouver's first jail and former meat-packing district. Chef Jasper Cruickshank blends classical French technique with West Coast ingredients, backed by a Platinum Award-winning wine list and a serious cocktail program. With over 15 years in operation and options to dine at the bar, mezzanine, or atrium, it is one of Vancouver's most celebrated dinner destinations.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact details (217 Carrall Street, 604.568.1701, labattoir.ca). The site confirms an active, full-service dinner restaurant with current menus, a bar program, and private dining. The Chef's Tasting Menu page explicitly states the menu 'can be crafted for pescatarians or vegetarians,' and the Le Petit Menu lists vegetarian dishes (Spinach farfalle, Crispy avocado), providing positive evidence for vegetarian options. No website content addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, takeout, or other cycling-specific amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible full-service restaurant in Gastown with current menus and confirmed contact details. A touring cyclist seeking a higher-end dinner stop in Vancouver would find this useful.
